sql1-3.solution: SELECT product_name, price, price / 1.255 AS price_ex_vat FROM products;

sql2-1.solution: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE category = 'Books' AND price < 35 ORDER BY price;

sql2-2.solution: SELECT customer_id, first_name, city FROM customers WHERE segment = 'Business' AND city IN ('Helsinki', 'Espoo');

sql2-3.solution: SELECT customer_id, first_name FROM customers WHERE city IS NULL;

sql2-4.solution: SELECT product_name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;

sql3-1.solution: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY status;

sql3-2.solution: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS products, ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products GROUP BY category;

sql3-3.solution: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) > 20;

sql4-1.solution: SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, c.first_name FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id;

sql4-2.solution: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL;

sql4-3.solution: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items AS i JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category;

sql5-1.solution: SELECT product_name, price FROM products WHERE price > (SELECT AVG(price) FROM products);

sql5-2.solution: WITH spend AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS total_spend FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.customer_id) SELECT s.customer_id, c.first_name, ROUND(s.total_spend, 2) AS total_spend FROM spend AS s JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id ORDER BY s.total_spend DESC LIMIT 10;

sql6-1.solution: SELECT category, product_name, price, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC) AS price_rank FROM products;

sql6-2.solution: WITH ranked AS (SELECT year(trip_date) AS year, trip_date, trips, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year(trip_date) ORDER BY trips DESC) AS rn FROM daily_trips) SELECT year, trip_date, trips FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY year;

sql7-1.solution: SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' AND year(o.order_date) = 2026 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

sql7-2.solution: WITH units AS (SELECT p.category, p.product_name, SUM(i.quantity) AS units FROM order_items AS i JOIN orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category, p.product_name), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS r FROM units) SELECT category, product_name, units FROM ranked WHERE r = 1;

sql7-3.solution: WITH per_customer AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE orders >= 2) / COUNT(*), 1) AS repeat_share_pct FROM per_customer;
